canonical_structural_program.name: CARRIER_INTERFACE_EXTRACTION
canonical_structural_program.question: What exact public interface does each complete G(k-1) carrier expose to the uplift?

canonical_structural_program.name: PAIR_CONNECTION_CENSUS
canonical_structural_program.question: Which ordered/unordered carrier pairs admit each declared connection attempt and what canonical outcomes result?

canonical_structural_program.name: PAIR_OUTCOME_QUOTIENT
canonical_structural_program.question: What is the minimal relabel-invariant quotient of pair connection outcomes under the declared observer?

canonical_structural_program.name: TRIPLE_COMPATIBILITY_IRREDUCIBILITY
canonical_structural_program.question: Are any joint triple facts not reconstructible from all unary interfaces and pair outcomes?

canonical_structural_program.name: COMPOSITION_CLOSURE
canonical_structural_program.question: Are the resulting higher assemblies closed under the candidate connection/composition grammar?

canonical_structural_program.name: CANDIDATE_Gk_STATE_DESCRIPTOR
canonical_structural_program.question: Is there a finite read/write state sufficient for all admitted higher-level transitions?

canonical_structural_program.name: RECURSIVE_CLOSURE_AND_GRADUATION_AUDIT
canonical_structural_program.question: Does the candidate grammar close recursively, survive holdouts, and satisfy every graduation gate?

earned_anchor.meaning: G1 grammar earned at historical O7 graduation

purpose: Freeze the layer-to-layer organizational uplift semantics before implementing G2 structural experiments.

terminology.C: candidate/reconnaissance experiment stage; never implies graduation
terminology.Gk: an earned organizational grammar/law at layer k
terminology.R: recursive application depth of an already graduated G grammar
terminology.S: canonical structural-uplift derivation stage acting on complete carriers from the previous earned G layer
terminology.legacy_O: historical discovery/maturation label retained only for provenance

triple_irreducibility_rule.pairwise_legal_but_jointly_illegal_alone: candidate signal only until relabel-invariant residual is identified and reproduced
triple_irreducibility_rule.positive_requires: two triple instances with identical canonical unary-interface multiset and identical complete canonical pair-outcome data but different canonical joint legality/outcome, OR a formally equivalent residual obstruction not represented in unary+pair data

uplift_unit_rule.atomicity: carriers are atomic with respect to the declared previous-layer public interface
uplift_unit_rule.connection_semantics: connection/composition attempts must be generated only from already-earned previous-layer interface/resource legality
uplift_unit_rule.failed_connections: must be recorded canonically; failure is scientific data, not discarded
uplift_unit_rule.hidden_internal_reads: FORBIDDEN unless explicitly preregistered as a nonpromoting observer capability
uplift_unit_rule.source: complete carriers produced by the immediately previous earned G layer
